exactSelectorLines.text: .shell-stage { position: relative; min-block-size: 0; isolation: isolate; display: grid; grid-template-rows: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; }

.shell-panel { position: absolute; z-index: 1; inset-inline: 0; inset-block-end: 0; block-size: 55%; min-block-size: 11rem; max-block-size: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: var(--mcr-paper); border-top: 1px solid var(--mcr-ink); }
.world-shell { --mcr-paper:#e9e1d4; max-inline-size:72rem; border:4px double #e8dfd0; outline:1px solid #191817; background:#191817; }

.world-shell::after { content:""; position:absolute; z-index:5; inset:0; padding:4px; pointer-events:none; background:repeating-linear-gradient(8deg,#e9e1d4 0 1px,transparent 1px 19px),repeating-linear-gradient(94deg,transparent 0 31px,#e9e1d4 31px 32px,transparent 32px 59px); mask:linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,linear-gradient(#000 0 0); mask-composite:exclude; }
